question: R1 item 2: assess laboratory aggregation sensitivity within the same original patients, labels, feature roster, folds and model family; not reproduce the historical encounter-versus-patient comparison.
label: Unchanged historical patient ever-MACE recorded-diagnosis label.
fixed_nonlaboratory_features: The original all-record means of age, sex, five regional fields and three numerically empty prior-diagnosis/department slots remain unchanged in every aggregation variant. Thus this is NOT a complete first-visit model.

variant_definitions.mean: Arithmetic mean of all finite numeric source values per patient/feature; exactly the frozen original mean matrix.
variant_definitions.first_record: Use all laboratory slots from the earliest recorded check-time row per patient, preserving its missing cells; ties use stable original CSV row order.
variant_definitions.first_observed: For each laboratory slot separately, select its first finite numeric value in recorded check-time order; different slots may come from different records and this is not a single baseline visit.
variant_definitions.median: Median of all finite numeric source values per patient/laboratory slot.

temporal_guard: Require complete parsable check timestamps for both cohorts before temporal variants are allowed; stop rather than substitute file order when dates are missing. Check time is not verified result-availability or event onset.
timestamp_tie_rule: Stable original CSV row order within tied patient/check-time groups; no clinical meaning or ordering is asserted within ties.
roles: Exact frozen 10/15 patient-role matrices; five outer patient-isolated folds. Inner role 2 fit and role 3 stopping; all nonzero roles for final refit. No patient or label changes.
model: Uncalibrated equal-weight XGBoost/RandomForest ensemble with original fixed parameters. Zero fill each variant as in original Chinese model. Fit-role labels only for class weights.
mean_baseline: Rebuild and require exact frozen matrix equality; replay each of 10 stored full models and require exact component and ensemble probability equality. Reuse those probabilities and models, without refitting them.
record_count_comparator: Log1p(total processed record count) as a single feature, StandardScaler and L2 logistic C=1 fitted only to outer-training patients. Descriptive recording-process comparator, not a deployable early risk model.
subgroup_interpretation: Stratify already held-out predictions by full-record count; do not retrain or exclude patients from the main experiment. Processed rows are check-record rows, not verified distinct hospital admissions.
between_centre_comparison: WHU minus SCH paired gains for each prespecified contrast; independent centre-specific patient bootstrap streams.
intervals: Nominal percentile 95% intervals conditional on fixed OOF predictions, not refitting uncertainty or a causal decomposition; identical patient multiplicities across variants within a cohort and stratum.
invalid_resamples: Omit only bootstrap draws with no positive or no negative label and record counts; do not relax strata or choose alternatives based on model performance.
prohibited: public patient rows or original identifiers
claiming causal mechanism from aggregation differences
